items.title: KLM to Cut Workforce by Nearly 15% in Major Cost-Saving Drive
items.summary: Despite improving profits, the Dutch airline says its future is far from guaranteed, with big changes needed to bring costs under control and restore competitiveness.

items.title: Minor Hotels Puts Its New Wellness Brand Inside a St. Regis It Owns
items.summary: Owning the building made this easy. Minor didn’t need anyone’s money to put its wellness brand inside a Marriott-run hotel. Getting an outside owner to pay for one, and agreeing with another brand on who keeps the client, will be harder.

items.title: Trip.com Group Builds a Bigger Travel Business Around Concerts
items.summary: The concert might be the reason to travel, but Trip.com Group wants to make sure it's not the only thing fans spend money on. Tickets and hotel rooms are just the opening act.

items.title: Choice Paid $24 Million to Walk Away From Buying Spain’s Sercotel
items.summary: Choice earns a cut of its franchisees’ room sales. Buying Sercotel would have left it owing rent even when bookings slowed.

items.title: The Unproven Economics of the Weekend Cruise
items.summary: Cruise lines are putting some of their biggest ships on shorter trips, but the financial evidence that those voyages generate better returns remains thin.

items.title: Why Scaling AI Agents Is Harder Than Building Them
items.summary: Scaling AI agents is less about the model than the systems, talent, and infrastructure around it. As travel companies move from pilots into production, they must decide which capabilities differentiate the business and which are better handled by a specialist.
